facts.big: I did it myself · by myself
facts.label: Pronomes reflexivos
facts.sub: myself, yourself, himself, herself, ourselves, themselves. By myself = sozinho, sem ajuda. Help yourself = sirva-se.

facts.label: Eu mesmo
facts.sub: Use myself quando o sujeito e o objeto são a mesma pessoa: I hurt myself. I taught myself. Em português, é “me” ou “eu mesmo”. Nunca diga I hurt me; use sempre o pronome reflexivo.

facts.label: Sozinho
facts.sub: Use by myself, by yourself, by herself para dizer sem ajuda: I did it by myself. Does she live by herself? A ideia é fazer algo sozinho, sem outra pessoa.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.why: Yourself is singular; the plural is yourselves.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Myself is for I. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
Yourself is plural. → Falso (Yourself is singular; the plural is yourselves.)
By myself means without help. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Doing it yourself in Austin · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a hot Saturday in Austin. Edith lives in a small blue house with a green door. She likes to repair things at home. Her neighbor Marco is walking by. He sees a new lock on her door. He stops to ask about it.

“Marco, look at the door. I changed the lock myself!” says Edith. “Really? Did you do it by yourself, or did someone help you?” says Marco. “I did it by myself. I watched a video and taught myself.” says Edith.
